title: How Fast Do Humans Actually Grow?
character: Full-body model sheet, plain white background, flat 2D vector illustration style. A friendly, smiling young man with neat brown hair, wearing a mint-green crewneck t-shirt, dark charcoal straight-cut trousers, white socks, and simple black sneakers. Clean geometric shapes, minimal shading, no harsh black outlines, soft modern vector aesthetic.
voice: Warm, bright, friendly, energetic pacing, clear educational inflection.
music: Light, upbeat electronic lo-fi beat with cheerful synth plucks and soft kick at 116 BPM, mixed low under voiceover.

scenes.vo: Have you ever wondered how fast humans actually grow?

figures.pose: Young man in mint-green tee standing upright, looking up curiously with one eyebrow raised, hands at sides.

scenes.vo: In year one, babies shoot up ten whole inches!

figures.pose: Cute baby version in a tiny mint-green romper, standing on wobbly feet with arms outstretched in excitement as height counter rapidly climbs.
figures.label: Year 1

scenes.vo: By age two, kids reach half their adult height.

figures.pose: Toddler in mint-green shirt standing proudly with hands on hips, smiling wide.
figures.label: Age 2

figures.pose: Full-grown adult man in mint-green tee smiling down gently and giving a thumbs up.
figures.label: Adult

scenes.vo: Then growth slows down to two inches a year.
scenes.photo: Clean 3D medical visualization of a healthy human knee and long leg bones, highlighting the active epiphyseal growth plate glowing with translucent cyan light against a dark navy clinical background.

scenes.vo: Girls hit their growth spurt two years before boys.

figures.pose: Twelve-year-old girl character in mint-green top standing confident and tall, waving happily.
figures.label: Girl (12)

figures.pose: Twelve-year-old boy character in mint-green tee looking up slightly bewildered at her taller height.
figures.label: Boy (12)

scenes.vo: At peak, boys gain four inches, girls three-point-five.

figures.pose: Teen boy in mint-green tee stretching upward excitedly as his height counter rapidly shoots up four inches.
figures.label: Boy Peak

figures.pose: Teen girl in mint-green top smiling cheerfully as her height counter rises three and a half inches.
figures.label: Girl Peak

scenes.vo: Feet grow first, so big shoes precede the height!
scenes.photo: A high-angle realistic photograph of a young teenager sitting on a school locker bench, wearing distinctly oversized high-top basketball sneakers resting on a polished gym floor.

scenes.vo: Deep sleep, protein, and activity maximize your range.

figures.pose: Young man in mint-green tee standing centered in confident athletic posture, smiling warmly at camera.

icons.prompt: Flat minimal vector icon of a crescent moon with soft twinkling stars.
icons.label: Deep Sleep

icons.prompt: Flat minimal vector icon of a protein bowl and running sneaker.
icons.label: Nutrition

scenes.vo: So how tall are you naturally destined to be?

figures.pose: Young man in mint-green tee pointing straight toward viewer with an inviting, curious expression.
figures.label: Your Height

scenes.vo: And there's way more inside our app. Get your personal routine in TallPlan.

figures.pose: Cheerful young man holding a smartphone showing a colorful habit tracker interface, smiling wide and waving invitingly.
